Proposition
[Jacobi fields characterize conjugate points] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0305 ↗ appb-def-conjugate-point ↗ appb-def-jacobi-field 1. Proposition B.12\group local-comparison-geometry

Let $(\mathcal M^n,g)$ be complete and connected. A point $q$ is conjugate to $p$ along a geodesic $\gamma $ if and only if there exists a nonzero Jacobi field $J$ along $\gamma $ with $J(0)=J(1)=0$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0305 \sketch The Jacobi field obtained by varying the initial velocity of a geodesic gives the forward direction, and the converse is immediate from the characterization of critical points of the exponential map.

□
